# WhatsApp Number Checker API

> Official code examples for the CheckNumber WhatsApp Number Checker API — a bulk, asynchronous, file-based API that verifies whether phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp. Upload a file of E.164 numbers, poll for completion, and download a result file marking each number yes/no.

Base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
Authentication: X-API-Key request header

## Workflow

1. Submit: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/tasks with form fields `file` (one E.164 number per line) and `task_type=ws`. Returns a JSON task object with `task_id` and `status`.
2. Poll: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/gettasks with form field `task_id`. `status` moves pending -> processing -> exported.
3. Download: when `status` is `exported`, download the file at `result_url`. Columns: `Number` (E.164) and `whatsapp` (yes/no).

## Variants (same workflow, change task_type)

- task_type=ws — real-time WhatsApp registration check; result column `whatsapp` (yes/no)
- task_type=ws_active — last-active window; result column `active`
- task_type=ws_avatar — profile enrichment; result columns such as `avatar`, `age`, `gender`

## Pricing

Per number checked, billed against account balance. Current rates: https://checknumber.ai/pricing
Check balance: GET https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/balance

## Docs

- Canonical documentation: https://docs.checknumber.ai/whatsapp-bulk-checker
- Dashboard and API keys: https://platform.checknumber.ai
